test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following government schemes was launched to provide financial assistance to start-ups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry and commercialisation on 19 April 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Start-up India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• SISFS aims to support** early-stage start-ups **by providing seed funding, which is crucial for validating innovative ideas and bringing them to the market. It helps start-ups bridge the gap between innovation and market entry by offering funding of up to** INR 50 lakhs.**
 
• SISFS is a **Central Sector Scheme** under the **Ministry of Commerce and Industry**, specifically managed by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (**DPIIT**).
 
• It aims to provide financial support to startups across the country, but it** prioritizes funding startups from Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities.**
 
• The scheme focuses on early-stage startups to help them transition through critical stages of their business development.
